index.t80: What types of conditions do you treat?
index.t81: We treat orthopaedic, neurological, sports, paediatric, and geriatric conditions — including back pain, neck pain, knee injuries, post-surgical rehabilitation, stroke recovery, cerebral palsy, and more.
index.t83: Yes. All our physiotherapists are highly qualified, certified in specialized techniques like Dry Needling, Manual Therapy, and Kinesio Taping, and have years of clinical experience.
index.t85: Yes. We provide professional physiotherapy at home with expert oversight and strong quality checks. Contact us to schedule a home visit.
index.t86: How do I book an appointment?
index.t87: You can easily book an appointment by calling us, sending a WhatsApp message, or filling out our online booking form. Our team will assist you in scheduling your session.
index.t88: How much does a session cost?
index.t89: Basic electrotherapy sessions start at Rs. 400/-. Manual therapy is Rs. 500/-, Cupping therapy is Rs. 600/- and Dry needle therapy is Rs. 800/-.
index.t91: Dr. U. Kalyani generally sees patients earlier in the day, while Dr. A. Prakash is available in the evenings. Our reception team can match you to the right physiotherapist and time based on your condition.
index.t93: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM – 8:30 PM. Sunday: 3:00 PM – 8:30 PM.

about.t23: Healing Hands Advanced Physiotherapy Clinic was set up to give patients in Hanamkonda direct access to experienced physiotherapists — without long waits or being passed between different staff for each visit.
about.t24: From musculoskeletal pain and sports injuries to post-surgical rehabilitation, our treatment rooms are equipped for hands-on assessment, electrotherapy, manual therapy and structured exercise-based rehab.
about.t30: Both physiotherapists at Healing Hands see patients directly, across different hours of the day.
about.t33: Our rooms are set up so each part of your treatment — assessment, electrotherapy, manual therapy and exercise-based rehab — has its own dedicated space.

faq.t19: Answers to the questions patients ask us most often. Can't find yours? Call the clinic directly.
faq.t21: Call the clinic directly or message us on WhatsApp with your preferred day and time. Our reception team will confirm your slot and let you know which physiotherapist is available.
faq.t23: No referral is required. You can walk in or call to book directly, and our physiotherapist will carry out an initial assessment before recommending treatment.
faq.t25: Your first session starts with a consultation and physical assessment to understand your condition. Based on this, the physiotherapist will explain a suggested treatment plan and begin initial treatment if appropriate.
faq.t29: Dr. U. Kalyani generally sees patients earlier in the day, while Dr. A. Prakash, a certified manual therapist specialised in Dry Needling, is available in the evenings. Our reception team can help match you to the right physiotherapist and time based on your condition.
faq.t32: This varies by condition. Your physiotherapist will give you an estimated number of sessions after your first assessment, and will review progress with you regularly.
faq.t34: For patients who are unable to travel, please call the clinic to check availability for select home-visit treatments.
faq.t36: Our team is happy to talk you through your options before you book.
